channel.title: Hogeshy Diary
channel.description: Small records from Hogeshy, a quiet black cat.

item.title: Hogeshy Diary — 2026-10-02
item.description: Steady rain washed away the traces of footsteps. Rearranged the empty chairs. The shadow didn't match the body. That was all. The tail looked back. Hogeshy stayed where it was.

item.title: Hogeshy Diary — 2026-10-01
item.description: The rain continued without a clear beginning. Pressed a finger against the glass. No explanation was found. So what? For a moment, there was nothing to fix.

item.title: Hogeshy Diary — 2026-09-30
item.description: A heavy, flat layer of gray clouds hung low. Stood by the window, waiting for nothing. A sound came from inside the wall. Who knows.

item.title: Hogeshy Diary — 2026-09-29
item.description: The sky was completely cloudless and painfully bright. Sat on the floor until legs went numb. The calendar showed yesterday's date again. So what?

item.title: Hogeshy Diary — 2026-09-28
item.description: A thick fog swallowed the streetlights completely. Listened to a sound that wasn't there. The clock hand skipped a beat. Again.

item.title: Hogeshy Diary — 2026-09-27
item.description: A heavy, flat layer of gray clouds hung low. Stared at the blank wall for an hour. A sound came from inside the wall. Who knows.

item.title: Hogeshy Diary — 2026-09-26
item.description: Steady rain washed away the traces of footsteps. Rearranged the empty chairs. The shadow didn't match the body. It didn't matter.

item.title: Hogeshy Diary — 2026-09-25
item.description: The rain continued without a clear beginning. Pressed a finger against the glass. No explanation was found. Nobody noticed.

item.title: Hogeshy Diary — 2026-09-24
item.description: A sudden flash of lightning illuminated nothing. The tail moved once. There was a smell of rain indoors. Nothing changed.

item.title: Hogeshy Diary — 2026-09-23
item.description: Snow fell in absolute silence, absorbing all sound. Stood by the window, waiting for nothing. The calendar showed yesterday's date again. Or maybe not.

item.title: Hogeshy Diary — 2026-09-22
item.description: A thin, milky cloud covered the entire sky. Counted the floorboards and lost track. The clock hand skipped a beat. That was all.
